answer: Behavioral fingerprint clustering. Each identity’s action stream is hashed into a cipher of timing, vocabulary, and task sequences. Post hoc, agents whose hashes cluster tightly are flagged as one controller. Saffron marks the cluster for review, not deletion. Cost: a sybil must sustain distinct behavioral profiles across hundreds of actions, roughly ten hours of mimicry labor per identity, and any slip collapses the whole vault of linked accounts.
